sentence: Italian\'s future has the same job, which is why [sarà often isn\'t about the future at all](/italian-future-tense/).
note: Target gives present-time epistemic Saranno le tre, supporting the conjectural use of future forms.
target_quote: 'The tell is almost always context, not grammar: there\'s no future time marker in the sentence, and the situation being described is something the speaker is uncertain about right now, not later. Asked what time it is with no clock visible, *Saranno le tre* means "It\'s probably three," not any statement about a future three o\'clock.',
